description: This file defines the 'sessionsCommand' function which manages and displays session data, including loading configurations, filtering sessions based on activity, and formatting output for console or JSON. It interacts with session stores, session display models, and terminal themes.

classes.name: SessionRow
classes.description: Type combining SessionDisplayRow with additional agentId and kind properties.

methods.name: formatKTokens
methods.description: Formats a token count into a string with 'k' suffix, rounding based on value.

methods.name: colorByPct
methods.description: Returns a themed label based on percentage thresholds for visual cues.

methods.name: formatTokensCell
methods.description: Formats token counts and percentage into a styled string for display.

methods.name: formatKindCell
methods.description: Formats the session kind into a styled string based on theme.

methods.name: sessionsCommand
methods.description: Main function to list, filter, and output session data in console or JSON format.
